description: Defines the IPlayerProperties interface with enums for audio/video codecs and playback resolutions, including methods for retrieving supported codecs, current resolution, and audio equivalence status.

classes.name: IPlayerProperties
classes.description: Interface for accessing player properties such as supported codecs, resolution, and audio equivalence.

methods.name: AudioCodecs
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator over supported audio codecs.

methods.name: VideoCodecs
methods.description: Retrieves an iterator over supported video codecs.

methods.name: Resolution
methods.description: Gets the current video playback resolution.

methods.name: IsAudioEquivalenceEnabled
methods.description: Checks if loudness equivalence is enabled.
